Behaviors
Positive point values show green, negative show red. Changing a value here only affects taps from now on — it doesn’t rewrite points already logged today.
Day
Archiving saves today’s totals below and zeroes every student back to 0. Do this at the end of the day, not between periods, if you want points to carry across periods.
Daily goals
A behaviour plan is usually written as “at or above N points, 4 days out of 5”. Set a daily target and this tool counts the days met — on the board, in the trends below, and on the printed summary.
Trends
Every archived day, per student. The bars run oldest to newest — a run of red on the right is the thing worth catching early.
Cumulative Totals
Running totals across every archived day — today's live totals join this once the day is archived.
